description: The pie chart illustrates matching statistics, displaying the distribution of a dataset across seven distinct categories based on the number of matches. The chart is divided into seven evenly joined slices, which are arranged clockwise in descending numerical order based on their category labels starting from the top. The largest slice, labeled "6 Matches," is colored light grayish-blue and represents 27.2% with a corresponding count of (8006). Continuing clockwise, the slice labeled "5" is light blue and accounts for 10.4% (3043), followed by "4" in very pale blue at 6.2% (1810), and "3" in pale olive green at 6.8% (2002). The "2" slice is colored pale greenish-yellow and makes up 22.4% (6583), the "1" slice is pale peach representing 13.8% (4046), and finally, the "0" slice is colored cream and accounts for 13.3% (3910). The chart does not utilize an external legend; instead, the numerical category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of their respective slices. Both the percentage values and their corresponding raw counts, enclosed in parentheses, are displayed directly inside each slice. None of the segments are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset, but they are clearly delineated by thin white borders.
